checks: Multiple CLI connections and multiple models from the same CLI persist independently
Automatic routing uses explicit user-assigned connections for quick, planning, coding and review tasks
Provider sessions are separate while execution directory and project identity stay shared
The next model gets the same disk files, shared brief and prior handoff without another project’s memory
Project handoffs and saved connections survive a server restart and are shared across linked chats

Existing folders link without copying files; workspace-mode and disk-root boundaries are enforced
Removed connections invalidate their routes and cannot silently select another model
scope: Local state, routing, handoff and engine-session tests with fixture managers. No external AI calls.
